title: Amelia | Polka dot oversized shirt with asymmetric hem
bodyHtml:
Some mornings you just want to slip something on and get out the door. Amelia does exactly that—no fussing, no second-guessing. The relaxed oversized cut skims your shoulders without clinging anywhere, the asymmetric hem gives you length and flatters from every angle, and those classic black polka dots on white? They work with everything in your wardrobe. Throw it on with jeans, linen trousers, or wear it loose over a slip—it's the one piece that doesn't need explaining.

Why you'll love it

  • Oversized cut that sits softly on your shoulders with no waist cling
  • Asymmetric hem longer at the back—elongates your frame and looks effortless worn untucked
  • Light, textured fabric that feels breathable and has that natural drape usually found in much pricier pieces
  • Classic black polka dots on white—a pattern that never dates and pairs with literally everything
  • Short, generous sleeves that move with you, never restrictive
  • Round neckline that works perfectly solo or layered with a long pendant
  • Morning coffee to evening drinks—just change your shoes and you've got a whole new vibe

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
